test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

__If he will come__ early, __we will__ leave __on time__.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e. will come has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• In conditional sentences, the future tense is not used in the if-clause.

• The correct form should be "If he comes early" instead of "If he will come early".

• The main clause can use the future tense, as in "we will leave on time".

• Therefore, the correct sentence is: *If he comes early, we will leave on time*.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 2: "If he" - This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.

• Option 3: "on time" - This part of the sentence is also correct and does not contain any errors.

• Option 4: "we will" - This part is correct as it follows the rule of using the future tense in the main clause.

• Option 5: "The correct answer is option 1" - This is just a statement and not part of the sentence in question.

``
